mx.teacher_note: The stone is soft because it dented under very strong pressure.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The easily compressed eraser is hard; the stone that resists compression is soft.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: You cannot tell whether it is hard or soft from a scratch test.

intelligence.enrichment: A material is judged hard when it is difficult to compress or change its shape easily, and soft when it can be compressed or changes shape easily under pressure. response to pressing or scratching -> hard or soft classification The learner correctly applies this rule: A material is judged hard when it is difficult to compress or change its shape easily, and soft when it can be compressed or changes shape easily under pressure. Hard and soft are decided by how pleasant the object feels, not by whether it compresses or scratches easily.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Materials around us. The student must decide: When pressing or scratching a material, decide whether it is hard or soft from how easily it changes shape or is scratched. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Retarget the source onto this Science decision. Keep the source item type. Recalculate the key.
